data.name: Leeladhar
data.long_meaning: Leeladhar is a name of divine origin, derived from the Sanskrit words 'leela' (play, sport) and 'dhar' (to uphold). The name symbolizes the divine play or sport of the gods, reflecting the concept of the universe as an expression of divine will. It is a powerful and auspicious name for a boy in Hindu tradition.
